sloka: लब्धार्था च प्रतीता च लेपयिष्यामि ते स्थगु ।मुखे च तिलकं चित्रं जातरूपमयं शुभम् ॥२-९-४९॥
transliteration: labdhārthā ca pratītā ca lepayiṣyāmi te sthagu ।mukhe ca tilakaṁ citraṁ jātarūpamayaṁ śubham ॥2-9-49॥

translations.english: O Manthara, I shall get a tilaka made of gold for your auspicious, lovely face and shall also order exquisite ornaments (for you).
